findings.title: Bot-wall/SSRF fallback keys off error text
findings.description: shouldRender classifies HTTP 401/403/429 via strings.Contains(err.Error(), "status 401") and isSSRFError via "ssrf:". Producers emit untyped fmt.Errorf (fetcher.go:137 "status %d"; outboundhttp/transport.go:56 "ssrf: refusing…") with no sentinel. Chromium fallback for bot walls and the SSRF-do-not-render guard are therefore a wording contract. A later wrap, HTTP %d, or errors.Is rewrite silently skips Chromium (worse metadata) or, if a new message happens to contain those substrings, launches a browser against a denied target. Every consumer of the same strings (fetch_fallback_test, metadata_handler_test) will keep the lie green.
findings.fix: Add sentinels (var ErrSSRF = errors.New("ssrf"); type httpStatusError struct{code int}) at the dialer/Fetch boundary, wrap with %w, and switch shouldRender to errors.Is/As. Keep the prefix only in Error() text for logs.

findings.title: Auth payloads read policy with Background
findings.description: liveFeatures(ctx) does policy.PasswordMinLength → Repository.Get (SELECT app_setting) on every auth-state payload. Me() anonymous/setup correctly pass r.Context() (handler.go:797/802). authenticatedPayload (824) and pendingPayload (twofa_handler.go:206/212/222) hard-code context.Background() because neither helper takes ctx — even though every production caller has *http.Request. Login, /me, 2FA challenge, OAuth convert, and session issue therefore ignore cancel/deadline/trace on a DB read that already exists for this request. Client abort still holds a pool conn; a future timeout on Get never applies on the hottest identity paths.
findings.fix: Thread ctx into authenticatedPayload/pendingPayload (first param) and pass r.Context() from startChallenge, Me, and the other JSON call sites. Tests can keep context.Background().

findings.title: TagPicker page clamp is effect-derived state
findings.description: useEffect([page, totalPages]) calls setPage(lastPage) when the filter shrinks the list. That is a value computable during render (safePage = min(page, lastPage)), not an external sync. Cost: extra commit (and a frame of an empty page) every time inline-create/filter drops totalPages; the same pattern will be copied into the next picker. setSearch already resets page to 0 — the effect only exists for the leftover overflow case.
findings.fix: const safePage = Math.min(page, Math.max(0, totalPages - 1)); slice with safePage. Drop the effect. Optionally setPage(0) inside setSearch/queue only.

findings.title: Optimistic entry patch asserts across the union
findings.description: optimisticEntryPatch types patch as Partial<Pick<Link, 'pinned' | 'preview_status'>> then writes `{ ...e, ...patch } as Entry` onto both link and note arms. Note has pinned but no preview_status (types.ts:181–195). The assertion turns the compiler off at the cache write: adding a Link-only field to the patch type (url, preview_error, og_image_url) will stamp illegal note rows into every ['entries'] page. Rollback restores the previous object, so the bug only shows while the mutation is in flight — exactly when cards re-render from cache.
findings.fix: Split the helper (patchLink vs patchNote) or narrow: if (e.kind === 'link') return { ...e, ...patch }; if ('pinned' in patch) return { ...e, pinned: patch.pinned }; return e. Delete the `as Entry`.
